sentences.text:
THIS W.P IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO QUASH ANNX-C THE NOTIFICATION ISSUED BY THE GOVERNMENT THROUGH INDUSTRY AND COMMERCE DEPARTMENT, U/S 28 (4) OF KIADB, ACT, 1966, VIDE NO.CI-245 SPQ2018, DATED 07.12.2018 AS BEING ARBITRARY ILLEGAL AND UNSUSTAINABLE AND ETC.,
 THESE PETITIONS, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER 1.

Certain lands situated in Survey No.57 of Singasandra Village, Begur Hobli, Bengaluru South Taluk, Bengaluru are acquired for the purpose of respondent No.2-BMRCL.
2.
The same is challenged in the instant writ petition.
3. Admittedly, the acquisition is made for a public purpose and no proper reason is assigned by the petitioners as to why the said acquisition has to be set aside.
However, in the course of the arguments, the learned counsel for the petitioners submits that he will be satisfied if the compensation amount is released.

The learned counsel for respondent Nos.2 and 3 submits that there is a dispute as to ownership of the lands concerned and for that reason, the award amount will be deposited before the Reference Sri. Chikkamuniyappa vs State Of Karnataka on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98073025/
4 Court within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.

sentences.text: 5. Their submission is placed on record.

6. For the aforementioned reasons, the Writ Petitions are hereby disposed of with a direction to respondent No.3 to deposit the compensation amount before the Reference Court within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order in respect of the lands which are the subject matter of the writ petition.
